exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
outcome: Transfer to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 43,422 term, cephalic, singleton, second deliveries in Norway between 1989-2009 after a first cesarean section
finding: Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) was associated with higher offspring mortality and lower 5-minute Apgar scores compared to non-TOLAC deliveries.
